# Upstream

- Repository: https://github.com/DenisSergeevitch/ex-ussr-kinship-research
- Imported commit: `5a430a2e8eb11ccf45ef8ed8e49c6abb8a1436d0`
- Imported on: 2026-10-25
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`

This directory is a verbatim vendor snapshot. Product-specific code must live
outside `vendor/` so a later refresh can replace this directory without a
manual merge.

To refresh it, clone the upstream repository at the desired reviewed commit,
replace this directory while excluding `.git`, restore this file with the new
commit and date, then run `npm test` and `npm run build`.
